changes_made: Removed authHeader parameter from IUserExits.preConnect() interface
Updated AbstractUserExits.preConnect() to match new signature
Updated LifecycleUserExits.preConnect() to match new signature
Updated UserExitsEventThrowerService.firePreConnect() — no longer accepts or distributes authHeader
Updated WebLoginComponent.sessionConnect() — firePreConnect called without authHeader

files_modified.changes: preConnect(createSessionRequest: CreateSessionRequest, authHeader?: string) → preConnect(createSessionRequest: CreateSessionRequest). Added VULN-005 security rationale comment.
Removed authHeader parameter from preConnect() signature.
Removed authHeader parameter and super call argument from preConnect().
firePreConnect(createSessionRequest, authHeader?) → firePreConnect(createSessionRequest). forEach call no longer passes authHeader.
sessionConnect(): firePreConnect call no longer passes authHeader.
sendCodeAndConnectSession(): firePreConnect call already had no authHeader; comment added.

defense_in_depth.primary_control: API contract change: plaintext-equivalent Basic auth credentials are no longer distributed to any user-exit implementation. The preConnect() interface signature makes it structurally impossible to receive credentials. User exits that need connection context can use createSessionRequest (applicationName, sessionDescription, options) without credentials.
secondary_controls: authHeader is still passed to sessionService.connect() internally — only the user-exit distribution is eliminated
Recommend: document the security contract in the IUserExits JSDoc — preConnect must not log or transmit connection parameters externally
